notes.name: READ ME — classification status
notes.html:
Purpose: First-pass historical-landslide screening layer.
Classes requested: Old scar / Possible old scar / Reactivated 2026 / New 2026 / Drainage-gully only.
Current limitation: The historical Google Earth material supplied is perspective screenshots, not georeferenced orthophotos. Therefore exact Old scar / Reactivated / New polygon assignments are intentionally not fabricated. Features are marked Possible/Uncertain until historical imagery is georeferenced or digitised directly in Google Earth/QGIS.
1997: retain as reported historical episode only until an independent dated record is attached.
Next QA: digitise 2005 and 2023 scars at native coordinates; intersect with exact 2026 inventory; then promote classes with confidence levels.
